instructions.question: Does the cited evidence, read in its original conversational context, express the proposed claim? Check what was reported, not whether it is independently true in the world. Preserve the subject, negation and qualifications. Do not demand a complete sentence within each transcript segment. If subject continuity is genuinely ambiguous, choose uncertain.
instructions.source_provenance: First-person I/we and numbered speakers do not identify the app user or device owner. A claim about the user is unsupported unless that identity is explicitly established in the transcript. A claim about an unidentified speaker can preserve first-person evidence.
instructions.context_rule: Read the ordered original passages in state.source as context. Transcript segmentation and punctuation can split an utterance. Missing speaker labels do not prove a speaker change; neither do labels prove identity. Do not bridge an explicit topic or speaker change, competing subjects or quotations by guessing. The claim must remain supported by its cited excerpts in this context. A claim is a proposal to check, never evidence.

criteria.supported: The source entails the asserted fact with its relevant qualifications preserved.
criteria.unsupported: The claim contradicts the source, adds an unsupported assertion, or removes a qualification that changes its truth.
criteria.uncertain: The supplied evidence does not establish whether the claim is true.

instructions.question: Does the proposed basis match how the speaker presents the claim? Stated means an unqualified assertion, including a preference; tentative means explicitly uncertain. A hypothetical, quotation about someone else, or advice must not become an unqualified assertion about the proposed subject. Speaker identity and external truth are separate questions.

instructions.question: Does the proposed temporal annotation match the report at capture time? Current means reported as an ongoing state then, not verified true today. A plain present-tense preference or ongoing property with no time qualification supports current with expression null. Preserve explicit historical, future, conditional and uncertain qualifications. Do not invent dates or infer completion.
